ruleDefinitions.name: Linux Shell Pipe to Shell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious process command line that starts with a shell that executes something and finally gets piped into another shell

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX("^sh\\ \\-c\\ ") OR process_command_line = RGX("^bash\\ \\-c\\ ")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\|\\ bash\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\|\\ sh\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\|bash\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\|sh\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX("\\|\\ bash$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\|\\ sh$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\|bash$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\|sh$"))))
